details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a significant downturn on November 5, with the total market capitalization falling by 5%. Bitcoin dropped below $76,000 from earlier highs of $80,000. This sell-off was linked to a sharp decline in US technology stocks and concerns over AI investment. Approximately $1.07 to $1.1 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated within 24 hours, predominantly long positions, affecting over 200,000 traders.
title: Crypto Market Drops 5%, Bitcoin Under $76K Amid $1.1B Liquidations

details: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis confirmed a security breach that exposed password hashes and live tokens for all users, leading to service shutdowns. The company also identified an "on-path attack" that compromised some customer passwords. Services like Reactor, Data Solutions, and KYT were taken offline. All users are required to reset passwords and rotate API keys.
title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes Passwords & Tokens, Forces Shutdowns

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is targeting a 2029 launch for its digital euro, following a 12-month pilot program scheduled to commence in the second half of 2027. This initiative aims to unify Europe's fragmented payment systems and reduce reliance on foreign card firms, promoting financial autonomy.
title: ECB Aims for Digital Euro Launch by 2029 Post-2027 Pilot

details: Injective (INJ) surged over 10% following the Nasdaq listing approval and launch of the Canary Staked INJ ETF. This new ETF, ticker INJC, offers staked exposure to INJ, with plans to stake at least 90% of its holdings, aiming to reduce liquid supply and provide staking rewards to investors via a traditional brokerage product.
title: Injective (INJ) Surges 10% on Nasdaq Staked ETF Launch

details: Polygon is considering a hard fork proposal to recover approximately 70.49 million POL tokens stolen in recent security incidents affecting Polymarket and Binance. The proposal, a Polygon Improvement Proposal (PIP), aims to zero out balances in five attacker-controlled addresses and credit them to verified recovery wallets. A vote and date for the hard fork are pending.
title: Polygon Proposes Hard Fork to Recover 70M Stolen POL
